title: pricecalc
goal: A small price calculator package: order total with tax, and an amount formatter.
acceptance_criteria: pricecalc.total.total(prices, tax_rate) returns the sum of prices plus tax, rounded to 2 places
pricecalc.fmt.fmt(amount) returns the amount with 2 decimals and ' RUB'
checks: from pricecalc.total import total; from pricecalc.fmt import fmt; assert fmt(total([10, 20], '0.1')) == '33.00 RUB'

tasks.title: Implement total
tasks.goal: Create pricecalc/total.py with total(prices, tax_rate): the sum of prices plus tax at tax_rate, rounded to 2 places. prices may be ints or strings; tax_rate may be a string.
checks: from pricecalc.total import total; assert total([10, 20], '0.1') == 33

tasks.title: Implement fmt
tasks.goal: Create pricecalc/fmt.py with fmt(amount) returning the amount with exactly 2 decimals followed by ' RUB'.
checks: from pricecalc.fmt import fmt; assert fmt(33) == '33.00 RUB'
